name: MagnetmeBot
description: Magnet.me's web crawler. It discovers and refreshes career-related pages — vacancies, events and employer information — for the Magnet.me careers platform. The operator documents that it may render JavaScript, follows the canonical version of a page, does not submit forms and adjusts its crawl speed automatically, and it publishes the addresses it crawls from as both a JSON and a plain-text list.
